integration_decision.name: POST_ORPHAN_RECOVERY_MUST_PROVE_BOTH_ARCHIVE_WRITE_AND_READ_PATHS
integration_decision.finding: At pinned runner.py, run_once(network=False, external_jsonl=()) calls append_observations(archive_path, collected) with collected=[]; pinned storage.py append_observations returns 0 before entering ArchiveWriterLock. The subsequent load_observations DOES enter the lock. Therefore a post-orphan run_once-only recovery assertion exercises archive READ lock and handoff publication but does NOT prove post-cleanup archive APPEND lock recovery. Existing orphan test establishes fail-closed behavior before test-owned cleanup, not successful post-cleanup read+write+handoff.
integration_decision.no_network_test_contract: On isolated tmp_path archive: spawn child with positive ArchiveWriterLock acquisition ACK, release to os._exit(17), join/confirm exitcode=17; assert orphan .jsonl.lock exists and a short ArchiveWriterLock acquisition raises TimeoutError without deleting lock. Only after confirmed child death explicitly remove the test-owned orphan and assert absence. Append one canonical PIT-visible rowB with append_observations(archive,[rowB]) == 1, then load_observations(archive) returns exactly rowB (write and read locks both reacquired). Run runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=T) and assert returned archive_records_loaded=1, scoring_records_loaded=1, source_errors=[], source_evidence rowB role=scoring with effective.source_record_id=rowB; assert persisted anata_latest.json has same identity. Assert no leftover lock, bounded child and operations; finally terminate child and remove only test-owned artifacts. Use no network/sleeps as oracle, no Specialist edits by Planner A. Keep frozen two-writer first/last-boundary, stale-generation rollback, and scoring/context identity contracts separate; no duplicate orphan restoration task.
